dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

My foster writes: Raveena is a classy lady!
She a total love bug and velcro-pup. All she wants to do is whatever you want to do! From walking through the park to sitting at home watching movies, Raveena is a true companion. She's a huge fan of naps and pets, always politely asking for you to come join her for a quick snooze or snuggle. She is a little strong on leash but she knows her name and comes when called, making for a smooth yet active walk. Raveena would love a calm home with humans who will give her a lot of love!

Raveena is a sweet older lady with lots of spry energy left to share. She simply wants to give you love and be near you!

My foster writes:
Raveena is an absolute sweetheart and anyone would be lucky to have her. She as happy on a walk as she is curled up in your lap on the couch - her size does not stop her from getting as close to you as possible! She is able to ask for pets by nudging with her hand, and enjoys treats. She enjoys human companionship and comes when called and is house trained. She would do well in a quiet home where she can lounge with her owner and also enjoy long leisurely walks exploring town. An affectionate, quiet girl, she deserves a home to relax in for her older years 💓
dog.name: Raveena
